questions.q: In which year did Turkmenistan become independent?
questions.why: It left the Soviet Union.

questions.q: Which status did the UN recognise for Turkmenistan in 1995?
questions.why: It is celebrated each December.

questions.q: Which first President called himself 'Turkmenbashi'?
questions.why: He renamed the months after his family.

questions.q: Which ancient Silk Road city near Mary is a UNESCO site?
questions.why: It may have been the world's largest city in the 1100s.

questions.q: Which ancient Parthian capital near Ashgabat is a UNESCO site?
questions.why: It has old fortresses.

questions.q: Which 1948 disaster destroyed Ashgabat?
questions.why: It killed tens of thousands.

questions.q: Which ancient city with tall minarets is in the north near Uzbekistan?
questions.why: It was the capital of Khwarazm.

questions.q: What is the capital of Turkmenistan?
questions.why: It has the most white marble buildings in the world.

questions.q: Which burning gas crater is called the 'Door to Hell'?
questions.why: It has burned since 1971.

questions.q: Which desert covers most of Turkmenistan?
questions.why: Its name means 'black sand'.

questions.q: Which sea lies to the west of Turkmenistan?
questions.why: It is the world's largest lake.

questions.q: Which underground lake in a cave is warm enough to swim in?
questions.why: It is around 33 °C.

questions.q: Which canal from the Amu Darya is one of the world's longest?
questions.why: It is about 1,375 km long.

questions.q: Which mountain range lines the border with Iran?
questions.why: Ashgabat sits at its foot.

questions.q: Which book written by Niyazov was required reading?
questions.why: It was part of the driving test.

questions.q: Who has been President of Turkmenistan since 2022?
questions.why: He took over from his father.

questions.q: Which former President is now Chairman of the People's Council?
questions.why: He is called 'Arkadag' (the Protector).

questions.q: What is the title of Turkmenistan's former President, meaning 'Protector'?
questions.why: A new city is named after him.

questions.q: Which Ashgabat landmark had a golden statue of Niyazov that turned with the sun?
questions.why: It was moved to the suburbs in 2010.

questions.q: Which dog breed is a national symbol and has a golden statue?
questions.why: It is a Central Asian shepherd dog.

questions.q: Which horse breed from Turkmenistan has a metallic coat?
questions.why: It appears on the national emblem.

questions.q: Which camel is common in Turkmenistan's desert?
questions.why: It is well suited to the heat.

questions.q: What is Turkmenistan's currency?
questions.why: Azerbaijan's currency has the same name.

questions.q: Which resource gives Turkmenistan great wealth?
questions.why: It has the fourth-largest reserves in the world.

questions.q: Which hand-knotted rugs are famous from Turkmenistan?
questions.why: A carpet design is on the flag.

questions.q: Which rice and meat dish is a national favourite?
questions.why: It is cooked for celebrations.

questions.q: Which tall lambskin hat do Turkmen men wear?
questions.why: It keeps the heat out.

questions.q: Which language is official in Turkmenistan?
questions.why: It is a Turkic language.

questions.q: Which giant mosque near Ashgabat is one of the largest in Central Asia?
questions.why: It holds Niyazov's tomb.

questions.q: Which day celebrates the horse each April?
questions.why: It is a national holiday.
